profile.headline: Highly experienced software developer. I am available for short term contract work.
profile.summary:
I'm currently available for both full-time and contract work. I'm an experienced software engineer with a proven history of solving complex problems across the entire stack. I work comfortably at any level - from writing efficient machine code to building complete web applications. My strengths include writing fast, clean C/C++ code, developing computer graphics systems, and designing and building user interfaces with the end user in mind, whether that's creating direct user-facing applications or developing UI libraries and graphics frameworks that other developers can build upon. I can dive into large existing codebases to fix and extend them, or build new systems from scratch. 

I'm a strong team player who values good working relationships at all levels. I enjoy collaborating with senior developers, helping junior teammates grow, and working closely with management to deliver results. My focus on meaningful collaboration and team success has led several previous employers to welcome me back after I'd moved on - a testament to both my technical skills and my ability to work well with others.

Specialties: Javascript, C/C++, C# & .Net, Qt, Windows, Linux/Unix, Assembler, Computer Graphics, UI

positions.title: Starfighter
positions.description: Defending the Frontier against Xur and the Ko-Dan Armada

positions.title: Principal Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
- Responsible for functionality to upconvert old Title effects to new Titler Plus tool. In C++.
- Evaluated several cross-platform mobile development environments for possible iOS and Android application development, including React Native and Flutter. 
- Implemented SRT video streaming from IOS in Flutter using open source libraries and Swift.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software design, architecture and development on Glance Live Video, co-browsing, and screen-sharing products. 

Upon retirement of the original developer I took responsibility for our real-time streaming Video web client and node.js server. This uses WebSockets in order to allow video streaming for clients that block WebRTC protocols. I improved performance, stability, error handling, and reporting and implemented new user-requested features, all in JavaScript. I also implemented extensive metrics for performance and quality reporting.

A customer had requested a real-time video background blurring solution in the browser for their in-house users, and we had no good solution. I took the initiative and built a solution using an open source Google tensorflow.js based machine learning model (BodyPix) for image segmentation (detecting the person on the webcam) and using WebGL for fast blurring and image processing, along with video capture from canvas all running in real time. This work resulted in an immediate large payment to the company and is an important feature in ongoing sales. Since then I have updated the machine learning models we use and further improved the performance of the WebGL background effects.

Earlier, I Improved desktop screenshare Windows and Mac clients including adding support for multiple monitors and display scaling. I also implemented new customer facing settings and interface pages. This work was C#/.Net, WPF, C++,  and some Objective-C.

Work has included use of JavaScript, node.js, WebRTC, WebGL, WebSockets, C# .Net, WPF
positions.insights: Skills: WebGL · Node.js · JavaScript · Software Architecture · Image Processing

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Senior Software Engineer

- Lead member on team implementing  Windows and Mac desktop application for customer product install, update and authorization. This is implemented as a single-page web app running in Google Chromium Embedded Framework ("CEF"). Worked on both server side C# and ASP.Net MVC and client side C++/JavaScript/Angular 1/HTML5/CSS3 for UI, SQL Server for database.
- Extensive work refactoring and improving customer product authorization servers, in C# ASP.Net MVC and SQL Server for better performance, maintainability and reliability.
- Helped resolve issues and redesign customer account workflows on corporate website in C# ASP.Net MVC and SQL Server
- Led project to reorganize source code and break up monolithic Git repository for efficient multi-team use.
- Developer on team implementing the popular Trash 2 audio plugin, in C++
- Extensive refactoring and improvement of custom Framework, including major improvements to UI framework and associated UI design tool.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Early stage startup.
User Interface design and programming for Windows in C++ using the Qt UI framework.  
- Extensive customization of Qt for a very unique UI including custom widgets, layouts, rendering, styling and event filtering.  Worked around a number of Qt bugs encountered along the way to achieve the results we desired.
- Targeting a touchscreen UI, implemented the specializations required throughout our application for an optimal touch experience.
- Designed and implemented a plugin based framework where independent application submodules were dynamically loaded into and managed by the main application.  
- Implemented UI and business logic for several modules and was heavily involved in the development of all the others.
- Designed and implemented a command messaging system for peer-to-peer signaling between users.
- Application was heavily multithreaded, and I assisted team members in debugging and resolving threading issues.
- Participated in, analyzed and incorporated into the application multiple rounds of User Experience testing.
- Using Javascript, XHTML and CSS in embedded browser (Webkit) implemented current weather (from NOAA REST interface) and user’s daily schedule (from XML).

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Renovate and enhance core UI of Avid's Media Composer Video Editing Application.  Required quickly understanding and enhancing and refactoring extremely complex and critical code, working closely with User Experience engineer and Product Owner.  Rapidly develop, test and refine UI enhancements based on feedback.

Previously, UI work on port to Qt and OSX.  Work on strategies for unit testing, UI functional testing.  Refactor C++ MFC UI code to Qt.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Software engineer working on a variety of aspects of an award-winning consumer audio device.  User interface implementation on a bitmapped grayscale remote, implement user features and infrastructure for a client-server RF remote.  Embedded ARM in C++ using gcc, running u-COS in a multi-threaded environment.  Implemented installers and software update application for Windows using MFC.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Collaborate in design of innovative new video and script authoring tool for Television Journalists, key contributor to the design of the most complex and powerful portion of the application.  
•	Implemented key portions of the editing application, including the Story Editing panel which incorporates much of the innovation in the product, on Windows XP in C++ utilizing Trolltech Qt UI framework.  
•	Implemented a portable menu design and layout system using XML as menu descriptors, implemented a menu design tool to simplify menu design.  
•	Implemented a Win32 fiber-based Task Scheduling system that is used heavily throughout the application.  This system allows creation and dispatching of lightweight tasks for polling, animation and other deferred or periodic application tasks, driven by a sophisticated scheduler.
•	Named as contributor in patent awarded for user interface design of story editor.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Sony Playstation 2 client, video streaming
•Implemented 2D graphics library for UI on PS2.  
•Architected and implemented a complete UI framework for PS2 in C++.  Implemented core structure of  prototype AOL client on PS2, including Instant Messaging, Mail, Internet Radio.  Responsibilities included graphics, UI and event handling, network interface and overall application structure.  
•Ported existing lightweight UI framework to PS2.  Extended framework with innovative UI elements created by a UI designer which enabled simple navigation of application functions.
•Ported On2’s  VP3 and VP5 video decoders to PS2.  Optimized VP5 decoder using MIPS machine language and proprietary Sony multimedia extensions.  Achieved performance improvements of over 40% which made use of this video decoder feasible.  Worked on optimizing MP3 and AAC audio decoders.  Ported AOL’s Nullsoft NSV multimedia multiplex streaming format to PS2, and implemented demo/test application supporting HTTP streaming.

positions.title: Engineer
positions.description:
Purchased FutureTense (see previous job)
•	Developed both Netscape Plugin and Microsoft ActiveX control  and supporting JavaScript to allow embedding a control in an HTML document that transparently connected to ContentServer (using HTTP) and downloaded a file, and launch an edit against that file.  The Netscape Plugin utilized Netscape’s LiveConnect and their JRI (Java Runtime Interfaces) to communicate with the page, the ActiveX control used Jscript and was implemented using ATL for COM support and for the user interface.
•	Continued support for ContentServer application enhancement, tools development and bug fixing.

positions.title: Engineer
positions.description:
Contractor, then employee
•	Developed an MFC grid control based on enhanced list control for use in various applications.
•	Developed several types of Windows-based editors and tools in C++ and MFC to allow editing of database records using HTTP and communicating with FutureTense Application Server.  These became the key customer tools used to implement their applications.
•	Further developed FutureTense’s main Windows based tool for developing and maintaining ContentServer applications.  In particular, added more powerful editing capabilities and support of and maintaining synchronization with external editors.
•	Enhanced and maintained core ContentServer functionality using Java language, in particular support for Tree structures using a flat database.

positions.title: Contractor
positions.description:
SNMP Management application for networked printer control and configuration
•	Designed and developed user interface to network printer control and management application.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
•  Developed UI prototypes and database wrapper classes in C++ and MFC for Windows 95 and Windows NT.
•  Implemented Windows User Interface for DNS server configuration, DHCP lease monitoring and control, and a generalized server status monitor.  This User Interface included multiple views of certain configuration data in order to provide higher level abstractions for easier data viewing and manipulation, and communicated with a remote database for data storage and retrieval.  Complications included very slow communication to the database and requirements for extensive data validation and error checking.

positions.title: Member of Technical Staff
positions.description:
Windows NT port of large technical publishing application.
•  Implemented complete OLE container functionality.
•  Designed and implemented Motif emulation over Windows including widgets and Xt layer for existing User Interface code, maximizing code sharing with Motif version of system, using C++ and Win32 SDK.
•  Designed geometry management methods and widgets as well as other widgets using C++ with widget classes paralleling Motif widget class hierarchy.
•  Maintained continuity and provided training and support for new team members through two nearly complete staff turn-overs, including Windows programming, C++, development environment and our class library.

positions.title: Project Technical Director/Software Engineer
positions.description:
•  Contributed to design and implementation of a popular high-end computer game (Ultima Underworld).
• Design and implement a scripting language for conversation trees.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
•  CELLworks/Unix - Converted QNX (80386 Real-time OS) applications in ‘C’ to run under Interactive I/386 and Sun UNIX, using Xlib, Xt and Motif.  
•  Developed UI subroutine library over X and Motif while providing most of the Motif widgets and allowing great flexibility in application layout and design.
•	Developed console design tool and graphical display design tool using the above mentioned library.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•  Principal Engineer on port of OPS (Office Publishing System) software to a 68000 based workstation running UNIX System V.  Required extensive problem solving due to lack of virtual memory and limited system memory and disk space.  Designed and implemented special features to handle Image scanning, cropping and translation.
•  Responsible for adapting existing RIPrint Command Interpreter to new RIP (Raster Image Processor) hardware for high-speed/high-resolution page printers.  Required implementing new high-speed, low-level raster operations to take advantage of hardware on new device.  Designed and implemented of Virtual Memory manager for the new device.

positions.title: Software Engineer/Consultant
positions.description:
•	Principal Investigator on National Science Foundation Small Business Innovation Research grant.  Wrote research plan that lead to the award of grant, performed all research including algorithm design and analysis, programming, testing and data analysis and optimization.  
•  Implemented new algorithms utilizing heuristics derived from analysis of the problem and results of tests.  
•  Wrote the final research report for the NSF.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Designed and implemented display drivers for the IBM Professional Graphics Controller in support of an Architectural CAD package, in ‘C’ on the IBM PC/AT.  
•	Developed commands and functions for 2D drafting system, provided general graphics support.

positions.title: Engineer
positions.description:
•	Designed  3D Graphics Editor for the Apple Macintosh PC.  Designed user interface and geometric data structures.  Supervised design of database and display systems.  
•	Programmed conversion of two popular arcade video games to home video game units.

patents.title: Editing system for audiovisual works and corresponding text for television news
patents.description: An audiovisual editing system that permits a journalist and other editors to edit both audiovisual and corresponding text segments included in a story. The data structure representing a story includes a list of media segments and a list of corresponding text segments. Each media segment has a type, such as script, SOT and voice, and includes a list of video clips. Each SOT segment or voice segment includes a list of timing control elements that determine the length of a media segment. The difference in the duration of the audiovisual material and the duration of the related text may be displayed to the editor, making it easier for the editor to match video to a script. Similarly, the duration of voice and SOT clips can be displayed to the editor, making it easier for the editor to match the video to the audio.
